0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
12 empty ::=
13 remember ::=
14 stmtseq ::= empty
15 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
16 fullstmt ::= barestmt
17 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
18 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
21 sideff ::= expr
22 cont ::= empty
23 startsub ::=
24 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs
25 attr ::= ATTRLIST
26 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
27 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
28 attrs ::= empty
29 attrs ::= attrs COLONATTR attr
30 attrlist ::= COLONATTR
31 optsiglist ::= empty
32 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
33 expr ::= listexpr
34 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
35 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
36 listexpr ::= term
37 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
38 termbinop ::= term ADDOP term
39 termbinop ::= termrelop
40 termbinop ::= termeqop
41 termrelop ::= relopchain
42 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
43 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
44 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
45 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
46 termeqop ::= eqopchain
47 termeqop ::= term NCEQOP term
48 eqopchain ::= term CHEQOP term
49 eqopchain ::= eqopchain CHEQOP term
50 termunop ::= PERLY_MINUS term
51 termunop ::= PERLY_PLUS term
52 termunop ::= PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK term
53 termunop ::= PERLY_TILDE term
54 termunop ::= term POSTINC
55 termunop ::= term POSTDEC
56 termunop ::= PREINC term
57 termunop ::= PREDEC term
58 term ::= termbinop
59 term ::= termunop
60 term ::= myattrterm
61 term ::= scalar
62 term ::= star
63 term ::= hsh
64 term ::= ary
65 term ::= arylen
66 term ::= THING
67 term ::= amper
68 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm attrlist
69 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm
70 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN myterm attrlist
71 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN term
72 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
73 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
74 myterm ::= scalar
75 myterm ::= hsh
76 myterm ::= ary
77 optlistexpr ::= empty
78 optlistexpr ::= listexpr
79 optexpr ::= empty
80 optexpr ::= expr
81 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
82 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
83 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
84 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
85 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
86 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
